senses.gloss: pr. n. (b. h.) Parvayim, name of a district or place known for its gold mines.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 11:3">Num. R. s. 11</cite> <he>מהו פ׳ שהיה עושה פירות</he> why is it named gold of P.? Because the trees made of it in the Temple bore fruit (v.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:4">Num. R. s. 12</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:10:3">Cant. R. to III, 10</cite> <he>אדום</he> (<cite ref="F00000"><he>ו</he></cite>)<he>דומה לדם הפ̇ר̇</he> it was red and looked like the blood of a bullock.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 103b:12">Snh. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>יש לנו זהב פרויים וכ׳</he> we have Parvayim gold …, let him take away his light; a. e.—[<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:4">Num. R. s. 12</cite> <he>עשו לה פרוים</he>, <he>מן פ׳</he>, read: <cite ref="Q01795"><he>פִּרְיוֹם</he></cite>.]
